description.value: Cafe Log is a coffee and desserts café occupying a second-floor unit in North Vancouver, previously operating under the name Snowy Village. It offers indoor seating in a no-smoking environment and is noted as wheelchair accessible. Cyclists looking for a sweet stop in North Vancouver may find it a quiet, sheltered retreat for coffee and desserts.
